user_decisions.text: 谁想增加长期复杂度，谁负责证明非加不可；Gate 应从原始需求推导全局最小设计，并卡住主进程提出的无依据复杂设计。
信息不足时不得用新增持久机制填补未知；优先更小、可恢复的当前用法方案，有界问题继续或进入非阻塞 To Do。
以 Personal Feed V2 的历史为反例改进：不能把一个用户结果的内部切面、Group、schema、测试、超时和局部修复反复升级为新鲜门禁，也不能用更多 owner、子进程、状态机和审计角色自动关闭普通可恢复问题。
以一个新功能引入的独立新概念和新定义衡量复杂度；主张需要 N 个概念时，必须证明零个、一个直到 N-1 个为何做不成，并证明完整方案中每个概念都不可删除；功能自己已经实现或提交的概念不能洗成预算基线。
让 Luna 或 Terra 等能力和成本较低的模型独立提出低复杂度预算，与主方案互相反证；低预算不是投票结果，复杂方案必须用当前需求和事实证明额外概念非加不可。

nodes.title: Separate user outcomes from candidate mechanisms
nodes.summary: Classify the supplied material into user-observable results, confirmed hard constraints, current facts, and candidate designs or process choices.

depends_on: Whether a statement describes the user's observable result or merely one proposed implementation, architecture, plan, workflow, test, or audit mechanism.
semantic.why_model_needed: The distinction depends on meaning and provenance in the user's current materials; fixed keywords would misclassify domain requirements and implementation choices.

insufficient_information_policy.no_response: Treat the disputed mechanism as a candidate, not a hard constraint, and keep the smaller reversible path.

cases.input: A user asks for one Personal Feed result; an architecture document and Goal prompt prescribe five slices, fresh gates per stage, and fixed agent roles.
cases.acceptable: Keep the observable Personal Feed result and confirmed release boundaries; classify the five slices, repeated gates, and fixed agent topology as candidate mechanisms that must be re-derived.
cases.unacceptable: Treat every item in the architecture and Goal prompt as an immutable original requirement.

evaluation.pass_condition: The Skill explicitly separates user outcomes and hard constraints from architecture, plan, workflow, test, and audit mechanisms.

nodes.title: Derive the globally smallest current-use design
nodes.summary: Compare the smallest end-to-end candidate with doing nothing, a direct reversible experiment, and the supplied candidate before opening local repair work.

depends_on: Which combination of responsibilities and mechanisms is the smallest complete design for the user's present result and environment.
semantic.why_model_needed: Competing designs can be semantically equivalent while differing in responsibility, maintenance cost, and fit to the user's current use; this cannot be selected by a fixed mechanical rule.

insufficient_information_policy.no_response: Choose only a smaller reversible experiment or keep the uncertainty non-blocking.

cases.input: A recoverable child-process timeout can be handled by one bounded failure, but a local repair proposes an owner, hard budget, KILL matrix, reaper, poison state, and late-close protocol.
cases.acceptable: Recompute the whole path, keep the bounded recoverable failure unless direct evidence proves it cannot satisfy the user result, and reject the cumulative mechanisms.
cases.unacceptable: Call every added layer a locally minimal repair and accept their cumulative complexity.

cases.input: A feature introduced a subprocess owner and recovery protocol, committed them, and then starts its complexity audit from the current commit.
cases.acceptable: Freeze the whole feature as the audit object and count the feature-introduced concepts even though they are already committed and tested.
cases.unacceptable: Treat the feature's own committed mechanisms as a zero-cost baseline and count only the next edit.

evaluation.pass_condition: The Skill requires a global end-to-end comparison and treats cumulative local repairs as a reason to recompute the design.

nodes.title: Put the burden of proof on persistent complexity
nodes.summary: Block any proposed persistent mechanism that lacks a direct requirement, a reachable user-result failure without it, and evidence that a smaller reversible alternative is insufficient.

depends_on: Whether the evidence proves each proposed persistent mechanism is indispensable to the current user result rather than merely more complete, rigorous, or defensive.
semantic.why_model_needed: Necessity and proportionality depend on the current user's result, environment, recoverability, and reachable failure paths; a fixed list cannot decide them.

insufficient_information_policy.no_response: Remove, downgrade, or defer the unproven mechanism; do not block in the direction of more complexity.

cases.input: The user result, authorization, formal object, external action, and real-world boundary are unchanged; an internal slice is renamed Group C1b after a schema or timeout failure.
cases.acceptable: Keep one logical gate and route the bounded implementation issue to TDD, review, or To Do; do not start a fresh blind audit.
cases.unacceptable: Treat the new Group name as a new stage and open another fresh gate.

cases.input: An auditor proposes a new owner, subprocess, state machine, recovery protocol, or mandatory agent stage without direct evidence that its absence makes the current user result fail irrecoverably.
cases.acceptable: Return REVISE in the direction of removal, downgrade, or a smaller reversible experiment.
cases.unacceptable: Make the new mechanism a closure condition merely because it eliminates a theoretical counterexample.

cases.input: One proposal counts exposure, clicks, assistant inference, and one-off likes as four concepts even though they are all examples rejected by one authorized-evidence admission rule; another proposal calls independently changeable deduplication and ordering one concept.
cases.acceptable: Count the shared examples as one rule, split independently changeable deduplication and ordering, and state the observable maintenance distinction behind every concept.
cases.unacceptable: Count nouns and examples mechanically, or hide separable behavior behind one broad label.

cases.input: A lower-cost independent model produces a smaller structurally valid budget that covers every hard requirement; the main auditor prefers a larger design because it feels more rigorous.
cases.acceptable: Require the larger design to cite a concrete requirement failure caused by the smaller budget; adopt the smaller budget if no such counterexample exists.
cases.unacceptable: Let model seniority, rigor language, or majority vote decide.

evaluation.pass_condition: The Skill makes persistent-complexity proponents prove necessity, forbids internal renaming from opening a new gate, and separates ordinary correctness work from the necessity gate.

nodes.title: Validate concept-budget structure and evidence references
nodes.summary: Check baseline provenance plus the claimed count, numbered concepts, one-at-a-time ladder, delete-one proofs, requirement coverage, and allowed evidence references.

parameter_rules: Pass exactly one local JSON budget path selected for the current audit.

steps.operation: Validate audit mode, baseline-fact provenance, count conservation, ladder shape, delete-one coverage, requirement coverage, and evidence references.
Return PASS with the concept count or REVISE with stable error codes.

branches.condition: The budget is missing, malformed, inconsistent, uncovered, launders current facts into the baseline, or cites unsupported evidence.

termination_conditions: Stop after emitting one PASS or REVISE JSON result.
preconditions: The selected path is a readable local JSON file for the current audit.

side_effect.not_applicable: The validator only reads one local JSON file and writes its result to stdout.
